# @aeon-ui/react-scene

Optional React layer for ambient visuals — pair with `@aeon-ui/signal`, `@aeon-ui/geometry`, and `@aeon-ui/surface`.

```tsx
import { SceneRoot, ProceduralGrid, SignalBars, SceneStage, SceneLayer, ScenePlane } from '@aeon-ui/react-scene'
import '@aeon-ui/surface/surface.css'
import '@aeon-ui/react-scene/scene-3d.css'
```

See [SCENE.md](../../SCENE.md).
